**步骤18: writetext**
- 参数: `{"content": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-\n\"\"\"剪贴板内容分析脚本\"\"\"\nimport os\nimport json\nfrom datetime import datetime\n\n# 剪贴板内容\nclipboard_content = \"G:\\\\OmniAgentAs-desk\\\\backend\"\n\ndef analyze_clipboard(content):\n    \"\"\"分析剪贴板内容\"\"\"\n    result = {\n        \"分析时间\": datetime.now().strftime(\"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S\"),\n        \"原始内容\": content,\n        \"内容类型\": \"\",\n        \"详细分析\": {}\n    }\n    \n    # 判断内容类型\n    if os.path.isabs(content) and os.path.exists(content):\n        result[\"内容类型\"] = \"文件路径\"\n        result[\"详细分析\"][\"路径\"] = content\n        result[\"详细分析\"][\"是否存在\"] = True\n        result[\"详细分析\"][\"路径长度\"] = len(content)\n        result[\"详细分析\"][\"来源应用猜测\"] = \"文件资源管理器\"\n    elif os.path.isabs(content):\n        result[\"内容类型\"] = \"文件路径(不存在)\"\n        result[\"详细分析\"][\"路径\"] = content\n        result[\"详细分析\"][\"是否存在\"] = False\n        result[\"详细分析\"][\"路径长度\"] = len(content)\n        result[\"详细分析\"][\"来源应用猜测\"] = \"文件资源管理器/浏览器\"\n    elif len(content) < 100:\n        result[\"内容类型\"] = \"短文本\"\n        result[\"详细分析\"][\"文本长度\"] = len(content)\n        result[\"详细分析\"][\"字符数\"] = len(content)\n        result[\"详细分析\"][\"来源应用猜测\"] = \"手动输入/复制\"\n    else:\n        result[\"内容类型\"] = \"长文本\"\n        result[\"详细分析\"][\"文本长度\"] = len(content)\n        result[\"详细分析\"][\"来源应用猜测\"] = \"文档编辑器/浏览器\"\n    \n    return result\n\ndef main():\n    analysis = analyze_clipboard(clipboard_content)\n    \n    # 输出报告\n    report = []\n    report.append(\"=\" * 60)\n    report.append(\"剪贴板内容分析报告\")\n    report.append(\"=\" * 60)\n    report.append(f\"\\n分析时间: {analysis['分析时间']}\")\n    report.append(f\"\\n原始内容: {analysis['原始内容']}\")\n    report.append(f\"\\n内容类型: {analysis['内容类型']}\")\n    report.append(f\"\\n详细分析:\")\n    for key, value in analysis['详细分析'].items():\n        report.append(f\"  - {key}: {value}\")\n    report.append(\"\\n\" + \"=\" * 60)\n    \n    report_text = \"\\n\".join(report)\n    \n    # 保存到文件\n    with open(\"E:\\\\test_dir\\\\clipboard_analysis.txt\", \"w\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:\n        f.write(report_text)\n    \n    print(report_text)\n    print(\"\\n报告已保存到: E:\\\\test_dir\\\\clipboard_analysis.txt\")\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    main()\n", "path": "E:\\test_dir\\analyze_clipboard.py"}`
